reward_source.primary: Acurast Pulse Mainnet chain-derived stake-neutral phone earnings
reward_source.base_definition: Deployment-neutral Pulse chain-derived baseline/day and observed ACU/epoch with deployment boost stripped; BASE is intrinsic hardware baseline
reward_source.low_definition: same current-epoch hardware baseline; 20% annual network/reward decay is applied only to long-horizon LOW accumulation
reward_source.high_definition: observed deployment-boosted ACU/epoch or +10% over hardware baseline, whichever is higher
reward_source.variant_policy: model-level Pulse aggregates are allowed; multiple variants lower bid-confidence only and never inflate BASE reward
reward_source.family_proxy_policy: same manufacturer/family + generation ±1; >=2 Mainnet Pulse references; minimum observed/baseline reward; LOW confidence and 0.50 bid factor

economic_invariant: Rank and bid on long-term ACU accumulation efficiency; ACU spot price is not a purchase gate.
ranking_metric: deployment-neutral Mainnet Pulse baseline annual ACU / verified DBA ASK DKK; evidence confidence only reduces bid basis
